meta.title: Defer UIA accessibility provider initialization until requested
meta.body_summary: Optimize UIA accessibility provider initialization by deferring creation to GetPatternProvider instead of eagerly creating in the constructor, claiming reduced overhead when patterns are not requested.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot deferred UIA provider init; maintainers flagged past Narrator breaks and required manual validation that never occurred; PR effectively abandoned without merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 36 changed lines in 2 files, this is a tiny, targeted C++ refactor. Despite minimal code changes, the PR remained unmerged due to the high risk of accessibility regression.

review_details.concern_detail: chiaramooney warned that prior accessibility provider initialization optimizations had broken Narrator; chrisglein agreed that manual testing is required and the Copilot agent cannot perform it.
review_details.performance_claim: Deferring UIA provider creation to GetPatternProvider reduces initialization overhead when accessibility patterns are not requested.
review_details.rejection_signals: Two non-author approvals but blocked by maintainers' accessibility concern; no manual validation performed or recorded; PR closed without merge.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot can implement lazy initialization pattern but cannot perform manual accessibility testing required for sensitive UI support; historical regressions make maintainers cautious.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainers reviewed the code change for correctness and flagged past Narrator breakages; no automated accessibility test existed.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No automated test for Narrator; manual validation is required and was never provided.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR received two approvals but was never merged; the conversation about accessibility risk remained unaddressed, effectively closing the PR.

core_change_summary.description: Moved UIA text and annotation provider creation from CompositionDynamicAutomationProvider constructor into GetPatternProvider with lazy initialization protected by null checks.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Change file added for beachball versioning per repo policy.
